personas.blurb: Computer Engineering junior selling her old desk setup and dorm gear. Has buyers messaging her.
Freshman furnishing a dorm on a budget, with a few conversations going (including a sketchy one).
Campus moderator. Reviews flagged listings, message reports and support tickets.

listings.title: IKEA Micke desk (white)
listings.description: Compact white desk with a drawer and a cable outlet. Fits the Chapultepec and Granada dorm rooms perfectly. Light scuffs on the top. Pickup near the Trolley stop.

listings.title: 27" Dell gaming monitor (1440p, 165Hz)
listings.description: Dell S2721DGF, barely used since I moved to a laptop-only setup. Comes with the original stand and a DisplayPort cable.

listings.title: TI-84 Plus CE graphing calculator
listings.description: Got me through Calc 1-3 and Linear Algebra. Rechargeable over USB, case included.

listings.title: Organic Chemistry (Klein, 4th edition)
listings.description: For the organic chemistry sequence. Light pencil notes in the margins, solutions manual included.

listings.title: Mini fridge with freezer box (3.1 cu ft)
listings.description: Keeps drinks cold and fits under a lofted bed. Cleaned and defrosted, ready to go.

listings.title: Road bike, 54cm aluminum frame
listings.description: Shimano Claris groupset, new tires and brake pads last month. Great for commuting to campus.

listings.title: Nintendo Switch OLED with two games
listings.description: White OLED model with dock and two Joy-Cons, plus Mario Kart 8 and Animal Crossing. Screen protector since day one.

listings.title: Yamaha FG800 acoustic guitar
listings.description: Comes with a gig bag, spare strings and a capo. A great beginner guitar.

listings.title: Two student tickets: Aztecs football vs. Fresno State

listings.title: Python and Java tutoring for intro CS
listings.description: Senior CS student, $25 an hour. Help with labs, debugging and exam prep. Meet at the library or over Zoom.

listings.title: Small three-shelf bookcase
listings.description: Some wear on the corners. Making room for a desk, so it needs to go this week.

listings.description: Brand new, sealed, no box. Cash app or gift cards only. Can't meet in person, I ship same day.

messages.text: Hi! Is the IKEA desk still available?
Yes it is! Are you on campus this week?
I'm in Chapultepec. Could I pick it up Thursday after 4?
Thursday at 4:30 works. I can meet you by the Trolley stop.
Would you take $65 for the mini fridge?
I could do $70 if you can pick it up this weekend.
Does the monitor come with the stand?
Yep, the original stand and a DisplayPort cable.
hey saw u looking at phones. pay with gift card and i ship today, super cheap
I'd rather meet on campus and pay in person.
no meet. send the gift card code now or someone else gets it

message_reports.reason: Asking for gift card payment and refusing to meet in person.
